skeletons.name: Label, then proof
skeletons.feel: A short line, then the product proving it, once per feature. Steady and clear.

learnedFrom.took: a dark lifted UI after each short line
the label card before each proof

skeletons.name: Rapid-fire
skeletons.feel: A cut on almost every other beat: a word, then two angles on the product. Hype.

learnedFrom.took: 0.5 s labels and 1–1.5 s proofs, 7.7 scene changes per 10 s, no stills
type and lifted UI alternating, the frame inverting between them

skeletons.name: One take
skeletons.feel: No labels between proofs: the camera travels the product, diving into each region on the beat. Calm.

learnedFrom.took: one tilted plane, the camera moving to the active part
zooms into regions of one continuous page
holding on one component while it works

skeletons.name: Type-led
skeletons.feel: Big words carry the film on alternating grounds; the product answers each one. For thin or sparse pages.

learnedFrom.took: a film that is mostly type, with a ticker of real terms
huge words on colour fields between lifted UI
words on black, cut hard on the beat
